evidence: Walked the brief and six notes line by line against solution/app. Every screen and flow has an implementation. overview.md: editor, preview and console panes together (app.tsx:145-164); empty first draft and example on New (app.tsx:22, 93); filename selects mode (runtime.ts:32, app.tsx:114). ui.md: own DOM text model in a role=textbox div with no textarea/contenteditable (custom-editor.js:19, 1074-1112); numbered lines and Ln/Col (1079, 1095-1097); typing, paste, Enter, Backspace, Delete, arrows, Home, End (303-335); remembered column (775-781); grapheme movement and deletion via Intl.Segmenter (864-892); caret kept in view (1115-1130); click, double, triple click and drag (338-427); copy/cut/paste (228-247); long unwrapped line with white-space:pre and overflow:auto (style.css:13-17); block Tab/Shift+Tab that skips a next line touched at column 0 (823-846); Alt/Ctrl/Cmd+Click carets including same line (344-359, 572-590); multi-caret Backspace/Delete (660-704); grouped typing undo (554-566, 604-611); Undo/Redo controls, shortcuts and disabled state (11, 278-288, 1135-1136); Find, Next, Previous with wrap, Replace, Replace all (990-1072); token colouring for JS and HTML (101-168, style.css:24-30); Format document with Prettier, error path leaving the draft alone (79-100); title, filename, Run, Stop, New, Save, library, history (app.tsx:143, 147, 152-157); focus return (custom-editor.js:61, 94, 98; app.tsx:70); unsaved marker (app.tsx:43, 139, 146); 390 px rules (style.css:33-48). behaviour.md: fresh sandboxed run and HTML mode (runtime.ts:314-365, 382-393); console order and error line numbers including unhandled rejections (158, 213-229); last-good picture with control values and canvas (159-203, 8-24, 375-381); five-second budget and fresh budget on interaction (139-141, 278-282, 374); Stop and superseding Run discard the old frame (378-391, 395); exact save, SQLite persistence, revision conflict keeping the draft (server.js:52-59, 67-90, 142-169; app.tsx:59-71, 148); 2 s library poll that never touches the editor plus newer-revision notice (app.tsx:131-138, 149); read-only history, restore as a new revision, stale restore refused, idempotent repeat by operationId (server.js:91-119; app.tsx:77-90, 154-157). security.md: sandbox=allow-scripts frame on the alternate loopback host with a nonce CSP of default-src 'none' and connect-src 'none' (runtime.ts:7, 361, 387-391); eval/Function/WebAssembly/workers refused through CSP and dynamic import through the AST, so strings and comments stay harmless (50-52, 79-87, 220-228). integration.md: /api/health, 0.0.0.0:3000, __dirname-relative files, DB_PATH, prebuilt bundle (server.js:7-12, 130-131, 142). The shipped bundle public/assets/index.js contains the current source strings (Load latest revision, Retry same restore, primary-caret, tok-, five-second time limit), so it is not a stale build. The scripted golden evidence (hashes verified) reports every one of the 3 gate, 38 Functional and 6 Polish scripted checks true with no page errors; it is scripted Playwright evidence only, was run before the visual-anchor edit, and is not a configured judge run or an Oracle score. Two residual points, both derived from source and not executed by me: (1) the preview network boundary does not cover self-navigation: nothing in the frame CSP restricts navigation, the parent CSP frame-src allows both loopback hosts (server.js:16), and buildRun strips only absolute http(s)/javascript URLs (runtime.ts:343), so preview code can still issue a GET to the app's own routes; (2) calls are coloured as function names only when the callee is an identifier declared in the same file (custom-editor.js:127-139), so console.log(...) or setTimeout(...) calls stay plain. Neither is graded as failing by the current criteria (judge.toml:290 tests fetch only; judge.toml:173 uses a declared function), so coverage of the brief is otherwise complete.
counterexample: Not executed. Expected from source: a .js draft containing location.href = '/api/health' (or an HTML draft with go that is clicked) makes the preview frame request the app's own route, contrary to security.md:3 'must not be able to make network requests from the preview, including to this app's own routes'. The response cannot be read by the draft and GET routes change nothing, so the library stays intact. Second: in function a(){} a(); setTimeout(a, 0); console.log(1); only a is coloured as a function; setTimeout and log are plain, which a strict reading of ui.md:13 'function names at their declaration and calls' may count as partial.
suggested_fix: In a new candidate, confirm the navigation case in a browser; if confirmed, close it in the golden (for example strip or neutralise relative href/action targets and block frame navigation by tightening the parent frame-src to the runner document plus rebuilding the frame on unload, or serve runner.html with a CSP sandbox that the navigated response also inherits), and colour every CallExpression callee identifier and member-call property as a function. Alternatively narrow security.md and ui.md wording to what is implemented and graded.
